text_block_list.text:
Finally, the day of the Takarazuka Kinen
arrives.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's get charged up for an
electrifying
race!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hayahide may be a strong rival, but I'm
armed
with tons of passion!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You can bet that I'll bring some super
exciting
moments to this race, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Oh, Hayahide! Good luck to both of us!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Let's make it a great race that really
wows the
audience!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: A race to wow them... I see.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah! So give me all you've got!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Of course. You had better do the same.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
